notes.title: Update 1.1.0 | Chapter 1.5
notes.content:
[h1]The latest update to version 1.1.0 with the release of chapter 1.5:[/h1]

[h2][u][b]News:[/b][/u][/h2]

[list]
[*] New SOLO mode added.
[*] New SOLO mode achievements added.
[*] New save system added.
[*] Save logo indicator added.
[*] Now, when you return from your trip, you reappear in the teleporter room..
[/list]

[h2][u][b]Modifications:[/b][/u][/h2]

[list]
[*] Option menu visual enhancement.
[*] Improved server-client coop system (in progress).
[*] Improved flashlight projection design.
[*] Modification of background sounds on the "Garfield Village" map and the "Rifly Station" map.
[*] Modifying images for achievements.
[*] No need to restart the game after deleting a savegame.
[*] Improved English translation.
[*] Improved menu.
[*] Improved skin-changing interface [COOP]..
[*] Improved fast travel system [COOP].
[*] Modification of the loading screen of the trip, you reappear in the teleporter room [COOP]..
[/list]

[h2][u][b]AVERTISSEMENT:[/b][/u][/h2]

[b]Following changes to the saves system, COOP mode data has been deleted to avoid any conflict with your session.

We apologize for the inconvenience.[/b]

Tree Games Interactive

notes.title: Journey To Destiny V1.0.3
notes.content:
Hey everyone! Here are some bug fixes:

[list]
[*] Added two portals on the map: Garfiel Village for players to choose their path.
[*] Added music to announce the success of each puzzle.
[*] Fixed the doors on the Rifly Station map.
[*] Fixed text display bug in the inventory.
[/list]

If you have any other bugs, don't hesitate to report them on the Discord server, they will be quickly fixed

Tree Games Interactive
